title: Eidolon Local API Setup Readiness V1
description: Whether this Host's Workspace authority answers for it, composed by the Local API from the Data plane. Unauthenticated, like the Host overview: whether a Host has been set up is what the phone in front of it is about to be told anyway.

state.description: absent: the Data plane has no Workspace for this Host, so setup can proceed. ready: it has one. unknown: it could not be asked, which a readiness gate must not read as a check that passed. There was briefly an orphaned state, for a Host whose Bootstrap held an Owner its Data plane had no Workspace for; Bootstrap no longer holds any of that, so nothing can disagree and nothing can produce it.
